title: Slicing Is All You Need: Towards A Universal One-Sided Algorithm for Distributed Matrix Multiplication
problem: Existing distributed matmul algorithms limited to specific partitioning subsets; requires operator redistribution with communication costs
motivation: AI and scientific computing require flexible partitioning strategies; current algorithms fragment support across 1D/2D/1.5D/2.5D variants
method: Universal one-sided algorithm using slicing (index arithmetic) for tile overlap computation; PGAS C++ framework with GPU-GPU communication
key_novelty: Index-arithmetic-based universal algorithm supporting all partitioning combinations; direct GPU-GPU communication via intra-node interconnects
limitations: Limited performance detail; comparison mostly qualitative
